mutants.description: ss_active is decoded as 'a soft-start sequence is under way', so it is also high during the S_HICCUP cool-down that leads into the re-ramp
mutants.reason: In S_HICCUP the ss_active port is high instead of low. That makes soft_start ramp and fault_arbiter count soft-start faults during the cool-down, so window_trip_SS can fire there and the retry into S_SS starts with a ramp that has already advanced.

mutants.description: run_active treats the hiccup cool-down as a pause inside regulation, so it is also high in S_HICCUP
mutants.reason: After a window_trip from S_RUN, run_active stays high through the whole S_HICCUP cool-down. soft_start then keeps SS_done and the full ceiling, so the retry is promoted out of S_SS without a fresh ramp. The strike_counter clean-run streak also keeps counting while the gate drive is off.

mutants.description: hiccup_active is decoded as 'a hiccup retry is in progress', so it also covers the re-ramp in S_SS, including the first start from S_OFF
mutants.reason: Whenever the FSM is in S_SS, hiccup_active is high. hiccup_timer then times a cool-down during soft start and does not clear hiccup_done when S_HICCUP is left for S_SS. strike_counter also sees an S_HICCUP entry on an ordinary start from S_OFF.
